text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86069, Tuscany Twist Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

The Twist Lost Wax Bronze Back-to-Back Pull Set has one of those designs that just looks like it belongs on the door to some historic building. The twisted design adds old world character that is only exemplified through the available finish colors. Choose from either flat black or medium bronze finishes. The Tuscany Twist Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick and comes packaged as a set of two pulls with back-to-back mounting hardware.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Twist Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Tuscany Twist Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Total Length: 9-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Width: 3/4"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Base: 1-1/4" square
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
